name: TOGAF Enterprise Architecture Practitioner (Level 2)
name_ja: TOGAF エンタープライズアーキテクチャ プラクティショナー

logistics.format: Computer-based scenario-based complex multiple-choice exam (Pearson VUE / online proctored), open book

formal: Must hold TOGAF Foundation (Level 1) or pass the combined exam

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Scenario-based application after Foundation supports associate architecture-method knowledge, with Japanese access aiding local use; eight questions and no experience requirement do not establish professional delivery ownership.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Scenario application following Foundation demonstrates associate use of an architecture framework. Zero experience and a short open-book objective exam do not establish professional security architecture responsibility despite broad recognition.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded scenario-based assessment and prior Foundation requirement demonstrate applied framework reasoning beyond terminology recall. With no experience requirement and no technical-security implementation, associate is the defensible level.
